feature_definition.anchor: mean of 10 earliest channel times in that scintillator
feature_definition.model_A: 62 raw translation-invariant features: 32 relative channels + first 24 sorted relative times + 6 order-statistic summaries
feature_definition.model_B_and_sigma: 52 features: 32 relative channels + first 20 sorted relative times, standardized with per-detector training scaler

time_model.type: blend of two independent per-scintillator HistGradientBoostingRegressor backfit estimators

sigma_model.note: Individual global sigma0/sigma1 normalization is not uniquely identifiable from DeltaT alone; training used a neutral gauge convention. Their quadrature combination is calibrated against DeltaT.
